title: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker working as a Maestros recruit to uncover how New Capenna beat the Phyrexians, who infiltrates the Cabaretti for Xander.

entities.name: Xander
entities.description: The horned vampire leader of the Maestros and curator of its museum, an original signer of the pact who is missing memories and hunts for the city's history.

entities.name: Anhelo
entities.description: A Maestros vampire who brought Elspeth into the family.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker with half-black, half-white hair and a bow who meets Elspeth at a drop-off and offers information on the looming threat.

entities.name: Jinnie Fay
entities.description: Jetmir's right hand in the Cabaretti, who gives Elspeth small jobs.

entities.name: Kitt Kanto
entities.description: A leonin songstress at a Cabaretti cabaret who brings Elspeth to Jinnie.

entities.name: Giada
entities.description: A teenager at Jinnie's table who wears oversized clothes.

entities.name: Rocco
entities.description: An elf bartender at the cabaret who refuses to help Elspeth.

entities.name: Jetmir
entities.description: The head of the Cabaretti.

entities.name: The Adversary
entities.description: A shadowy threat strangling the Halo trade and destabilizing the five families.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: Elspeth's friend who sent her on the mission to uncover how New Capenna beat the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Daxos
entities.description: Elspeth's lost love, whom she tries to banish from her mind.

entities.name: Maestros
entities.description: The vampire family of Xander, whose museum holds relics and archives of the city's founding.

entities.name: Cabaretti
entities.description: The family said to have the Font, a way to make unlimited Halo.

entities.name: Obscura
entities.description: The family whose door receives Xander's package.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: A group Vivien guesses Elspeth gathers information for.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: A monstrous threat Elspeth sees in the museum's artwork and aims to stop.

entities.name: Angels
entities.description: Founders of New Capenna in a deal with demonlords who left the city.

entities.name: Raccoonfolk gang
entities.description: Raccoonfolk who ambush Elspeth in an alley.

entities.name: Xander's museum
entities.description: The Maestros' museum in Park Heights where Elspeth catalogues questionable art.

entities.name: Park Heights
entities.description: The upper district that houses the museum and wooded meeting areas.

entities.name: Mezzio
entities.description: The district where Elspeth delivers a package to an Obscura door.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: The city founded by a pact between angels and demons.

entities.name: Halo
entities.description: A glowing magical substance, the last gift of the angels, that heightens strength and magic.

entities.name: The Font
entities.description: The Cabaretti's rumored way to make unlimited Halo.

entities.name: The Crescendo
entities.description: A Cabaretti celebration drawing near.

events.summary: Elspeth works as a museum recruit, cataloguing artwork that hints at Phyrexians, and decides the curator Xander knows more.
events.quote: The leader of the Maestros wasn't collecting all these relics by chance.

events.summary: Xander tells Elspeth that to learn more she must work for it, and she agrees to take jobs that make her a true member of the family.
Elspeth delivers a sealed package to an Obscura door in the Mezzio.
events.quote: Elspeth placed the package in her palm and promptly left.

events.summary: Xander tells Elspeth that New Capenna was founded by a deal between archangels and demonlords against an unknown enemy, and that he is one of the original signers.
events.quote: "Yes, I am, indeed, one of those original signers and have willingly become part demon

events.summary: Elspeth tails a Maestros informant across rooftops to a door in a shadowed alcove.
events.quote: The vampire knocked on the door and waited.

events.summary: Raccoonfolk ambush Elspeth in an alley and she bowls them over.
events.quote: she spun and used him like a battering ram to bowl over the others.

events.summary: Xander gives Elspeth Halo to drink, describing it as the last gift of the angels.
events.quote: "Halo was the last gift of the angels."

events.summary: At a Park Heights drop-off, Elspeth meets the planeswalker Vivien, who promises information on a looming threat.
events.quote: "One most certainly is, and we share motivations. I'm Vivien, by the way."

events.summary: Elspeth declines to leave with Vivien, wanting to learn how New Capennans beat the threat; Vivien agrees to contact her later.
events.quote: "I'll look further into these matters also and contact you when I have more information."

events.summary: Xander tells Elspeth about the Adversary and the Cabaretti's Font, and orders her to infiltrate the Cabaretti and leave a door unlocked.
events.quote: tell me where the Font is kept and leave a door unlocked.

events.summary: Xander names Elspeth an officer of the Maestros and gives her a knife; she demands full access to his archives in return for this last job.
events.quote: "Do this for me, and all the knowledge in my archives will be yours."

events.summary: Dressed in Xander's tailored outfit, Elspeth visits a Cabaretti cabaret looking for work and is rebuffed by the bartender Rocco.
events.quote: Rocco gave her a look that said, Who do you think you are? and promptly walked away.

events.summary: Kitt Kanto takes Elspeth to Jinnie, who agrees to give her a few small jobs for the Crescendo.
events.quote: "Then I think I have a few small jobs for you.

relations.quote: In walked a horned vampire—Xander, leader of the Maestros.
You wanted one, and you have earned it, as an officer of my Maestros.
Jinnie. The right hand of Jetmir, the head of the Cabaretti.
you should have all the details of them," she said with a grave note.

relations.note: carries out his jobs in exchange for information
relations.quote: "I held up my end of the bargain, now for yours."
